Our goal is to ensure that our clients feel supported and can focus on providing care to the populations they serve. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with software support and client-facing work.
cond_0212.responsibilities:
You will be responsible for the following:
Support user-facing applications
Provide superior client service and ensuring outstanding quality
Troubleshoot and document software operations
Complete thorough documentation of issues
Ensure the required response and resolution times are met
Collaborate with and support other team members
cond_0212.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience
Relevant exposure in customer service
Proficiency with MS Office and Windows OS
Experience with cross-functional collaboration
A strong desire for learning and professional growth
1+ Year(s) of technical support
1+ Year(s) of customer service
Willingness to work additional or irregular hours as needed
Working in accordance with corporate and organizational security policies and procedures
Performing other responsibilities as assigned
cond_0212.values: We value acting with integrity and keeping the interests of others in view. We aim to create positive outcomes through work that is respectful, fair, and responsible.

A large part of the role is staying in regular contact with clients to ensure they feel supported and can focus on providing care to the populations they serve.
cond_0501.responsibilities:
You will be responsible for the following:
Support user-facing applications and stay in close contact with clients throughout the process
Deliver strong client service and maintain outstanding quality in every interaction
Troubleshoot and document software operations, walking clients through issues as they arise
Complete thorough documentation of issues
Ensure the required response and resolution times are met
Actively connect with and support other team members, contributing to shared solutions
cond_0501.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience
Relevant exposure in customer service
Proficiency with MS Office and Windows OS
Experience with cross-functional collaboration
A strong desire for learning and professional growth
1+ Year(s) of technical support
1+ Year(s) of customer service
Willingness to work additional or irregular hours as needed
Working in accordance with corporate and organizational security policies and procedures
Performing other responsibilities as assigned
